name: grind-in-public
description: Personal lifelong-learning workspace maintained by **Wahidyan Kresna Fridayoka**.

scripts.build: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier heavy --disk-path . -- nx run-many -t build
scripts.check:go-vulnerabilities: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- go -C tools tool govulncheck -scan module
scripts.check:governance: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier light --disk-path . -- ./rhino governance word-budget validate
scripts.check:harness-parity: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier light --disk-path . -- ./rhino harness adapters validate
scripts.check:hygiene: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- ./rhino gate run --surface main
scripts.generate:bindings: ./hippo run --class transactional --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- ./rhino harness adapters generate
scripts.validate:harness-bindings: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- ./rhino harness adapters validate
scripts.check:markdown-links: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier light --disk-path . -- ./rhino md internal-link validate
scripts.check:project-contract: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- sh -c 'node --test scripts/project-contract.test.mjs && exec node scripts/check-project-contract.mjs'
scripts.check:workflow-contract: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- sh -c 'node --test scripts/workflow-contract.test.mjs && exec node scripts/check-workflow-contract.mjs'
scripts.check:workflows: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier light --disk-path . -- go -C tools tool actionlint "$PWD"/.github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.lint: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- nx run-many -t lint
scripts.test:coverage: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier heavy --disk-path . -- nx run-many -t test:coverage
scripts.test:behaviour: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- nx run-many -t test:coverage:behaviour -p wahidyankf-www
scripts.test:e2e: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier heavy --disk-path . -- nx run-many -t test:e2e
scripts.test:integration: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- nx run-many -t test:integration
scripts.test:scheduled: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier heavy --disk-path . -- sh -c 'nx run-many -t test:quick && nx run-many -t test:coverage:integration -p wahidyankf-www && exec nx run-many -t test:e2e -p wahidyankf-www-e2e'
scripts.test:unit: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- nx run-many -t test:unit
scripts.test:quick: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- nx run-many -t test:quick
scripts.typecheck: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- nx run-many -t typecheck
